### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **5** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@objectstack/plugin-approvals`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **62** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **3** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/ui.json`, `packages/spec/src/ui/index.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**30** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json e8de8a7ece08da5875cb50186eed3b6509a367c8`.

⛔ **11** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **3** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/ui.json`, `packages/spec/src/ui/index.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `sys_user (symbol, 43 pages)`
- **4** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **151** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json e8de8a7ece08da5875cb50186eed3b6509a367c8` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `a3f6527f068c586b3c6b716ab1ea0c5004442207` — the merge of head `e875a56445ed6ccec00d46a7edaf8d37baaa2529` into base `e8de8a7ece08da5875cb50186eed3b6509a367c8`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin a3f6527f068c586b3c6b716ab1ea0c5004442207 && git checkout a3f6527f068c586b3c6b716ab1ea0c5004442207
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin e8de8a7ece08da5875cb50186eed3b6509a367c8 e875a56445ed6ccec00d46a7edaf8d37baaa2529 && git checkout -B drift-repro e8de8a7ece08da5875cb50186eed3b6509a367c8 && git merge --no-ff e875a56445ed6ccec00d46a7edaf8d37baaa2529

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json e8de8a7ece08da5875cb50186eed3b6509a367c8
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs e8de8a7ece08da5875cb50186eed3b6509a367c8` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对

ACCEPT · #24814 · `domain:spec` seat 2 (seat post #18549) · `sunhaolin` · session `session_01PC4NPXPgPmpDRG9DdDnyXT` · 2026-10-24T12:23Z · head `e875a56445` · report `6383834597` · seat review at `TIER_DEFAULT`. Both clause-② limbs hit (path: `ui/component.zod.ts`, `ui/action.zod.ts`, `ui/action-copy-template.ts`, `automation/flow-text-slot-template.ts`, `system/i18n-resolver.ts`, `ui/index.ts`; declaration: `Clause-②: yes`), so a same-shape `## Contract review` PASS at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` on the landing head is still owed. `needs:contract-review` is added in this stroke.

1. **Shape.** Draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #24814`, no other closing keyword. `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: semantic` and `Ruling-ref: 6365736632` are line-initial in the body. The changeset carries both declarations, at `minor` on `spec`, `lint`, `cli`, `platform-objects` and `plugin-approvals` (the #24947 precedent's form). 46 files, +1209/−179 (`get_files`), not governed, under 3000 lines (`check-governed-merges --pr 25637`). The claim surface was amended this round (`6384157751`) for the `plugin-approvals`, dogfood and `cli/explain.ts` files the PR declares.
2. **The ruling, measured on the diff.** Letter A: the console first (met: `.objectui-sha` `2958f17e9c6a`, unlock `6377096620`), then one action-copy family in the #24947 form. The 9 row slots (`component.zod.ts`, `actionRowCopy`) and `ActionSchema.confirmText` / `successMessage` (`action.zod.ts`, keeping the inline locale map) are template slots; the blank arm is kept. Door findings are warnings (advisory at the publish gate, no exit-code change). The judge now prescribes `{{ x }}` for a `${x}` token. The 4 named `${result.*}` sentences are converted. Roots were measured at the pinned runner: `confirmText` over `record` (plus `params` only beside static values), `successMessage` over `result` then `record`, and `errorMessage` over none. `emptyText` is untouched (out of scope by the ruling). The parsed shape moves from string to envelope; the changeset says so, `templateSlotSource` reads both, and the downstream shape check the unlock asked for passed (`build-console.sh` with objectui at `2958f17e9c6a` against this branch's spec, canary green).
3. **Gates.** Check-runs on `e875a56445`: 36 success, 6 skipped, 0 failed (CI converged). Local, per the report: `--ran` 119/119 with no NOT MEASURED; spec, lint (159 files), platform-objects (94), plugin-approvals (95), cli unit (327) and the named metadata-protocol / rest / runtime / service-i18n / dogfood conformance suites all green. The dogfood boot test `member-transfer-ownership-step-down` is left to CI's battery (declared). Ablation on `isDollarToken`: 4/45 red, then restored. Landing waits for the contract-review PASS.
4. **Deviations accepted.** (a) The in-place extension to the 9 `sys_approval_request` toasts (`${result.request.record_title}`) beyond the ruling's "4". Four conditions checked: same defect class, mechanical, no other claim (PR #25600 on `plugin-approvals` has merged), same gate family. The claim surface was amended the same round, and the PR body names it with the 13-producer census. (b) Files outside the original surface that the new type needs: the dogfood conformance ledger rows and boot test, and `cli/src/commands/explain.ts`. (c) The slot's template input is built in each declaring `.zod.ts` (the expression-surface census scans only `*.zod.ts`). (d) Model-free trailers and the role file's PR footer. `mcp_calls` 0; relay writes 2.
5. **Open questions and out-of-scope outcomes.**
   - `ActionSchema.errorMessage` and `outcomeMessages` stay as they are: the ruling's letter. A follow-up only on a maintainer ask; Acceptance notes.
   - The `${…}`-aware prescription stays in the closed-scope judge only (the flow text slots never carried `${…}`): Acceptance notes.
   - The refusal half (blank text and door findings as errors, the #25205 analogue): the ruling orders it filed when this card lands. The seat files it at the merge.
   - Studio's action inspector and preview read the three keys as `I18nLabel` maps and would show an envelope as "template" (objectui #13409's note): Acceptance notes (an authoring-surface observation; no producer writes the envelope form today).
   - The expression-surface ledger row `template-bulk-confirm-text` still says no evaluator is found: carried by objectstack-ai/objectui#13183.
   - **Concurrency:** PR #25626 (`plugin-auth`, open) also edits `platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts` and the four `platform-objects` locale bundles. Different regions. Whichever lands second merges `origin/main` and regenerates the bundles with `check-i18n-bundles --write`.
6. **Landing.** Not governed, 1388 changed lines. Once the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` PASS is on record and every check on the then-current head is green, the seat sends `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` through the relay. At the merge the seat files the refusal-half card.

Contract review absent: tier quota wall · `domain:spec` seat 2 · 2026-10-24T12:26Z

The `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` reviewer for this head (`e875a56445`) was dispatched and stopped before writing anything. The host answered HTTP 429, rate_limit: the account's quota for the model behind `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` is used up, with no reset time given. The rule for a mandatory tier is to wait for it, not to step down: `references/platform-readings.md` 「强制档不因临缺授权降档…不达档起隔离达档子代理或等档」, and `references/landing-operations.md` 「子代理起不来 ⇒ 复核缺席,PR 带 `needs:contract-review` 留 draft 队列外;旁路仅维护者逐次亲审」. So this PR stays draft with `needs:contract-review`. The review re-runs on this head (or the then-current one) when that tier answers again. The only bypass is the maintainer's own review of this PR.
